parole.testo: Borrowed from Old Church Slavonic каѳисма (kaθisma), from Byzantine Greek κάθισμα (káthisma).
Old Church Slavonic кли́росъ (klírosŭ), then Byzantine Greek κλήρος (klḗros). Metathesis possibly through крило́ (kryló) ("side of the building").

parole.significato: pagan, heathen (not adhering to an Abrahamic religion)
parole.testo: Inherited from Old Ruthenian ꙗзычникъ (jazyčnik), from Old East Slavic ѧзꙑчьникъ (języčĭnikŭ), from Old Church Slavonic ѩзꙑчьникъ (języčĭnikŭ), a calque of Byzantine Greek ἐθνικός (ethnikós). By surface analysis, (archaic) язи́к (jazýk, “ethnos”) + -ник (-nyk).
From Old East Slavic ігу́мен (igúmen), from Old Church Slavonic игоумєнъ (igumenŭ), from Byzantine Greek ἡγούμενος (hēgoúmenos).
